title: test_multihop_latency_bounds.py: Test silently passes with insufficient delivery data
description: Line 432: test_bursty_traffic_latency_bounded uses MIN_DELIVERIES_FOR_STATS in an `if` condition rather than an `assert`. When stats.count < 10, the test passes without verifying latency bounds. Compare to line 122 which correctly asserts minimum deliveries. The test should fail when there is insufficient data to make statistical claims, not silently pass.
close_reason: test_bursty_traffic_latency_bounded now asserts MIN_DELIVERIES_FOR_STATS and p99 instead of skipping when count < 10.
